PDF 다운로드 및 서비스 재시작 금지\n\n---\n\n### 2. 소스 변경 세트 (Unified Diff)\n\n#### (1) 가드 정책 모듈: `sps/persona_source_runtime/guard.py`\n\n```diff\n--- a/sps/persona_source_runtime/guard.py\n+++ b/sps/persona_source_runtime/guard.py\n@@ -1,15 +1,28 @@\n import os\n+from pathlib import Path\n from typing import Optional\n from sps.persona_source_runtime.exceptions import (\n     UnauthorizedRoleError,\n     UnconfirmedSourceWriteError,\n     TargetNotAllowedError,\n )\n from sps.persona_source_runtime.models import AgentRole, PatchRequest\n\n+# 허용된 단일 대상 수집기 Python 경로 (Canonical Path 기반 화이트리스트)\n+ALLOWED_COLLECTOR_TARGETS = {\n+    Path(\"src/collectors/samsung_fire.py\").resolve(),\n+}\n+\n class PersonaSourceGuard:\n     \"\"\"Guards source modifications with strict PARTNER-only and target whitelisting.\"\"\"\n\n+    @staticmethod\n+    def _normalize_and_validate_path(target_path: str | Path) -> Path:\n+        resolved = Path(target_path).resolve()\n+        if resolved not in ALLOWED_COLLECTOR_TARGETS:\n+            raise TargetNotAllowedError(f\"Modification target not permitted: {target_path}\")\n+        return resolved\n+\n     def validate_patch_request(self, request: PatchRequest) -> None:\n         # 1. PARTNER 역할 검증\n         if request.caller_role != AgentRole.PARTNER:\n@@ -19,6 +32,9 @@ class PersonaSourceGuard:\n         if not request.source_write_confirmed:\n             raise UnconfirmedSourceWriteError(\"source_write_confirmed must be explicitly True.\")\n\n+        # 3. 대상 파일 화이트리스트 검증 (삼성화재 수집기 파일만 허용, 그 외 일체 거부)\n+        self._normalize_and_validate_path(request.target_file)\n+\n     def prepare_patch_evidence(self, target_path: Path) -> dict:\n         \"\"\"Capture full before-image and SHA256 digest prior to patching.\"\"\"\n         resolved = self._normalize_and_validate_path(target_path)\n```\n\n#### (2) 런타임 패치 실행기: `sps/persona_source_runtime/runtime.py`\n\n```diff\n--- a/sps/persona_source_runtime/runtime.py\n+++ b/sps/persona_source_runtime/runtime.py\n@@ -35,6 +35,9 @@ class PersonaSourceRuntime:\n         # 가드 정책 사전 검증\n         self.guard.validate_patch_request(request)\n\n+        target_path = Path(request.target_file).resolve()\n+        evidence = self.guard.prepare_patch_evidence(target_path)\n+\n         if request.dry_run:\n             # Dry-run: diff 적용 가능 여부 및 구문 검증만 수행하고 파일 시스템 쓰기 생략\n             simulated_content = self._simulate_patch(target_path, request.patch_diff)\n             return PatchResult(\n                 success=True,\n                 dry_run=True,\n                 target=str(target_path),\n                 evidence=evidence,\n                 message=\"Dry-run successful. No changes written.\",\n             )\n\n         # Apply: 백업 스냅샷 저장 후 원본 쓰기 및 검증\n         backup_path = self._save_rollback_image(target_path, evidence[\"before_content\"])\n         try:\n             self._apply_patch(target_path, request.patch_diff)\n             return PatchResult(\n                 success=True,\n                 dry_run=False,\n                 target=str(target_path),\n                 evidence=evidence,\n                 backup_path=str(backup_path),\n                 message=\"Patch successfully applied to Samsung Fire collector.\",\n             )\n         except Exception as e:\n             self.rollback(target_path, backup_path)\n             raise e\n```\n\n---\n\n### 3. 검증 테스트 세트 (`tests/test_persona_source_runtime.py`)\n\n요구된 네 가지 핵심 시나리오(비승인 거부, 비-PARTNER 거부, 비대상 Python 파일 거부, 삼성화재 수집기 정상 패치)를 검증합니다.\n\n```python\nimport pytest\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom sps.persona_source_runtime.models import AgentRole, PatchRequest\nfrom sps.persona_source_runtime.guard import PersonaSourceGuard, ALLOWED_COLLECTOR_TARGETS\nfrom sps.persona_source_runtime.runtime import PersonaSourceRuntime\nfrom sps.persona_source_runtime.exceptions import (\n    UnauthorizedRoleError,\n    UnconfirmedSourceWriteError,\n    TargetNotAllowedError,\n)\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef runtime(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    dummy_collector = tmp_path / \"src\" / \"collectors\" / \"samsung_fire.py\"\n    dummy_collector.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    dummy_collector.write_text(\"class SamsungFireCollector:\\n    pass\\n\")\n\n    monkeypatch.setattr(\n        \"sps.persona_source_runtime.guard.ALLOWED_COLLECTOR_TARGETS\",\n        {dummy_collector.resolve()},\n    )\n    return PersonaSourceRuntime(), dummy_collector\n\n# 1. Non-PARTNER 에이전트 쓰기 거부 검증\ndef test_reject_non_partner_write(runtime):\n    rt, target = runtime\n    req = PatchRequest(\n        caller_role=AgentRole.STANDARD,  # Non-PARTNER\n        source_write_confirmed=True,\n        target_file=str(target),\n        patch_diff=\"\",\n        dry_run=True,\n    )\n    with pytest.raises(UnauthorizedRoleError):\n        rt.execute_patch(req)\n\n# 2. 미승인(source_write_confirmed=False) 쓰기 거부 검증\ndef test_reject_unconfirmed_write(runtime):\n    rt, target = runtime\n    req = PatchRequest(\n        caller_role=AgentRole.PARTNER,\n        source_write_confirmed=False,  # Dry-run 검증\n    dry_req = PatchRequest(\n        caller_role=AgentRole.PARTNER,\n        source_write_confirmed=True,\n        target_file=str(target),\n        patch_diff=sample_diff,\n        dry_run=True,\n    )\n    res_dry = rt.execute_patch(dry_req)\n    assert res_dry.success is True\n    assert res_dry.dry_run is True\n    assert \"before_content\" in res_dry.evidence\n\n    #
